title: BlazBlue: Copyright Infringement Extend
author: iamthelobo
selftext:
So my personal litmus test for AI models has been how well it can clone my favorite game, BlazBlue.... other models were able to get something very crude but would really fall apart when I would try to tune it. For this experiment  I used Astra high, unity, bbtools to get the character sprites and other data. My prompt was basically "use the data you can find about blazbue's mechanics. Start by cloning ragna. I iterated by saying what didn't feel right and what to tighten. I got the camera dialed in by recording a video of gameplay from the actual game to show astra the limits.

This is obviously not something I plan to release... but I just have to acknowledge that this is insane.
